hints.title: Time Bucket Frequency Partitioning
hints.text: Record occurrences under their tweet name and categorize timestamps into minute, hour, or day chunks.

hints.title: Binary Search or Bucket Tallying
hints.text: Divide the interval [startTime, endTime] into fixed-length windows and count events falling in each slot.

hints.title: Interval Delta Mapping Blueprint
hints.text: Determine chunk step size (60, 3600, or 86400). Create an array of size ceil((endTime - startTime + 1) / step) and populate counts.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log N + N) record, O(B * log N) query
variables: N: number of timestamps for tweet
B: number of buckets in query
complexity.notes: Bisection identifies bucket boundaries in logarithmic time per chunk interval.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full unsorted scans across millions of events yield linear per-query latencies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted timestamp lists enable range count difference via binary search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct frequency delta mapping and bisect range boundaries.
